title: On Vortex Atoms
container-title: Proceedings of the Royal Society of Edinburgh
note: Lord Kelvin's vortex-atom proposal: atoms as knotted or linked vortex rings in the ether, with chemical species distinguished by knot type. Read 18 February 1867; the Proceedings volume carries the date 1869 (Cambridge Core record). Bibliographic data verified 2026-11-22; free PDF at https://zenodo.org/records/2101269/files/article.pdf.
